testCase.name: [dev] S13 No bleed between contexts: Hospital view never shows a Nursing Home task, even by direct URL

descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-07 Task Export · S13 「模式之间不串台：医院界面绝不显示养老院的任务，直接输入网址也不会」 No bleed between contexts: Hospital view never shows a Nursing Home task, even by direct URL

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U1 One consolidated in-app end-of-day view lists every open task across all of the physician's patients, each attributed to its patient（UAT TC-07；TFA-92585 AC 2） — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr
  • U10 All of the above works in both Hospital and Nursing Home（UAT TC-07；UAT 3.3；TFA-92585 AC 12） — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr
  • U9 'Email Tasks' is absent from the task screen: the button and the functionality, not just unused（UAT TC-07；TFA-92585 AC 11） — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr

测试设计方法：错误推测（error-guessing） — 专门去撞最容易出错的地方（失败、重复点、两个标签页、时钟不对、注入的指令）。

Given Standard fixture; one open task added on each chart

When Hospital selected: open Hospital Task Export, then type /snf/tasks directly; switch to Nursing Home: open its Task Export, then type /rounding/tasks directly

Then Each screen shows only its own context's patient and task; a direct URL never renders the other context's task inside the current screen and is never blank

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：TC-21 'no data leakage' applied to the task screens. mustContain/mustNotContain per checkpoint; cp1 and cp3 also carry the runnable no-Email / no-mailto check for both contexts (S02 / S06 are blocked). cp2 and cp4 can only judge that nothing leaks: 'renders, not blank, no error' is in spec.manual for a person (oracleRules 7), and what the screen should be is Q2. …

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 AGENT · 浏览器 agent；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（automated）

S13 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-07.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：AGENT · 浏览器 agent；辅助：VISUAL · 视觉（截图给人看） — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev。
